title: Prepay Already Standing to a Member's Credit and a New Booking, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
Money already held to a member's credit ahead of the season is counted against the ceiling of a fresh prepay booking, and how much of it is counted follows whether the programme lets money booked against one input class be drawn against another.

**Clause.** Where prepay stands unapplied on the account and the programme allows prepay booked against one input class to be drawn against another, the share counted against the gross ceiling is 100 percent. Where prepay stands unapplied on the account and the programme does not allow that, the share counted against the gross ceiling is 50 percent. In every other case no share of standing prepay is counted against the gross ceiling on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

| Prepay standing unapplied on the account | Money booked against one input class drawable against another | Share counted against the gross ceiling |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | allowed on the programme | 100 percent |
| yes | not allowed on the programme | 50 percent |
| none standing | either | No share is counted |

## Which programmes allow the transfer

| Programme | Booked money drawable against another input class |
| --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | no |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | no |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | no |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | yes |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | yes |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | yes |

*Hypothetical reading.* On the Early Pay Prepay Program Account, where the transfer is allowed, prepay of 18000.00 USD standing unapplied is counted against the gross ceiling in full. The same 18000.00 USD standing on a programme that does not allow the transfer is counted at 9000.00 USD.
